mossling.name: Mossling
mossling.lore: A clump of moss that grew a grudge. Harmless alone; the glade is never alone.

glade_wisp.name: Glade Wisp
glade_wisp.lore: A lost thought of the forest, still looking for the mind that made it.

thornhound.name: Thornhound
thornhound.lore: A hound of briar and patience. It does not chase. It is simply already ahead of you.

fae_marauder.name: Fae Marauder
fae_marauder.lore: A courtless fae making a living from the edges of a dying story.

corrupted_treant.name: Corrupted Treant
corrupted_treant.lore: Something hollow took root inside an old guardian. It still tries to protect the glade — from everything.

elder_hollow.name: The Elder Hollow

phases.message: The Elder Hollow splits its bark. Something inside is awake.
The glade holds its breath. The Hollow stops pretending to be a tree.

elder_hollow.lore: The first tree of Greenward, hollowed out by a grief older than the elves. It does not hate the living. It simply cannot remember how to let them go.
